zh-Hans.description:
随时，给自己一休。
不必等到有空，才可以休息。

一休冥想，是你的日常休息与声音陪伴。午休、夜里醒来，或工作暂时卡住的时候，听一会儿自然声与轻柔音乐，给自己留一个小小的空隙。无需经验，不必完成课程，也没有连续打卡。

【从这一刻开始】
午休一下：在“静心”选择 15 分钟午休，让湖岸自然声陪你短暂放下工作。
夜里醒了：听 15 分钟轻柔窗边雨声。不必刷手机，也不必急着做什么。
工作间隙：用免费的 1 分钟呼吸，暂时离开眼前的任务。
这三个入口都可免费使用。可以跟着呼吸，也可以只听声音，随时停下。

【27 个声音免费，打开就能听】
完整声音库有 54 个声音：14 种自然声、20 首古典名曲、10 首 AI 原创及 10 首其他冥想与氛围音乐。
免费聆听其中的 10 种自然声、10 首古典、5 首 AI 原创，以及绿洲停歇和初息。
从海浪、屋檐雨、溪流与鸟鸣，到德彪西、萨蒂、巴赫与贝多芬，选择当下想听的声音。
「十段安静」由一休创作、AI 辅助生成，每首配有独立风景。声音来源与授权可在 App 中查看。

【不打扰你的节奏】
无需注册，没有广告。免费使用 5、15、30 分钟定时与一分钟呼吸。开启后台播放后，锁屏或使用其他 App 时也能继续聆听。
声音库支持按用途、类型、免费、收藏与最近听过筛选，也可搜索声音、曲名或作曲家。“我的”保留继续聆听与喜欢的声音，不必每次重新寻找。
本机记录可帮你回看完成的练习；没有目标、排行榜或连续打卡要求。

【更多陪伴，按需选择 Plus】
Plus 提供完整声音库、60 分钟与不限时聆听，以及 3、5、10 分钟呼吸练习。支持恢复购买。经验证的 1.2 或更早版本用户保留原有 14 种自然声权限。
免费内容不要求订阅。购买前可查看 Apple 显示的价格与适用优惠。

【把一休时刻分享出去】
将当前场景生成带二维码的图片海报，通过系统分享发送给朋友。支持中英文切换、iPhone 与 iPad。

【数据由你选择】
偏好与练习记录保存在本机。使用统计默认关闭，可在“我的”自愿开启或随时关闭。练习手记不上传，统计不用于广告追踪。

订阅通过 Apple 自动续期，可在系统设置中管理或取消。
隐私政策：https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
使用条款（Apple 标准 EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

en-US.name: Yixiu: Sleep Sounds & Calm
en-US.subtitle: Rest, Breathe & Unwind
en-US.promotionalText: You do not have to wait for free time to rest. Take a lunch break, listen when awake at night, or breathe for one minute. 27 sounds free. No account, ads or streaks.
en-US.description:
Make room for quiet.
You do not have to wait for free time to rest.

Yixiu is your everyday rest and sound companion. At lunch, when awake at night, or between tasks, take a small pause with nature sounds and gentle music. No experience, courses or streaks required.

START WITH THE MOMENT YOU HAVE
A lunch break: choose 15 minutes with peaceful lake sounds in Focus.
Awake at night: listen to 15 minutes of soft rain at the window. There is nothing you have to finish.
Between tasks: take one free minute to follow your breath.
All three shortcuts are free. Follow your breath or just listen, and stop whenever you like. The Sounds home stays an uncluttered, immersive player.

27 SOUNDS FREE TO ENJOY
The complete library has 54 sounds: 14 nature scenes, 20 classical works, 10 AI-assisted originals and 10 other meditation and ambient tracks.
Enjoy 10 nature scenes, 10 classical works, five AI-assisted originals, Oasis Rest and First Breath for free.
Listen to waves, rain on eaves, streams and birds, or music by Debussy, Satie, Bach and Beethoven. The Ten Quiet Moments originals are created for Yixiu with AI assistance, each paired with its own landscape. Recording credits and licenses are available in the app.

KEEP YOUR OWN RHYTHM
No account. No ads. Free 5, 15 and 30-minute listening timers and a one-minute breathing practice. Enable background playback to keep listening with your screen locked or while using another app.
Find sounds with purpose and type filters, search, Free, Favorites and Recent. Return to continued listening and favorite sounds under Me. Completed practice records stay on this device, with no targets or streaks to maintain.

MORE ROOM WITH YIXIU PLUS
Plus offers the full sound library, 60-minute and unlimited listening, and 3, 5 and 10-minute breathing sessions. Restore Purchases is supported. Verified owners of version 1.2 or earlier keep access to the original 14 nature sounds.
Free content does not require a subscription. Apple shows the price and any eligible offer before purchase.

SHARE A QUIET MOMENT
Create a scene poster with a QR code and send it through the system share sheet. Switch between English and Chinese. Made for iPhone and iPad.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
Preferences and practice records stay on your device. Usage analytics is off by default and can be enabled or withdrawn under Me. Journal notes are not uploaded, and analytics is not used for advertising tracking.

Subscriptions renew automatically through Apple. Manage or cancel in system Settings.
Privacy: https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
Terms (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.whatsNew:
Make room for quiet.

• Three free Focus shortcuts: a 15-minute lunch break, nighttime listening and one minute of breathing. The Sounds home stays uncluttered.
• Filter by purpose and sound type alongside search, Free, Favorites and Recent.
• Start listening while purchase access is checked in the background, then apply verified access.
• More balanced levels across the ten AI-assisted originals, preserving their gentle dynamics.
• Refined amber membership gems, bilingual navigation and clearer Favorites. Philosophy and Lifestyle are directly visible.

Existing free content, subscription prices and privacy choices remain unchanged.

reviewNotes:
Version 1.21 (38), replacing draft build 36. No login is required. Focus contains three free everyday-rest shortcuts: lunch (15-minute Morning Lake), night waking (15-minute Window Rain), and a one-minute breathing break. The Sounds home intentionally has no scenario strip.
Catalog remains 54 active sounds / 27 Free. Ten AI-assisted originals have calibrated playback levels; their original-source identity, attributions and Free/Plus split remain unchanged.
Startup playback may begin while StoreKit verifies access. This is bounded by a 30-second readiness watchdog, then the verified legacy/Free policy is applied; later verified transactions are still applied. No permanent subscription is granted from pending state. Confirmed Free restrictions, Restore Purchases and verified legacy rights remain intact. No DEBUG, forced-access or YIXIU_INTERNAL_PLUS code is present in the uploaded Release binary.
Favorites has an explicit library action, including an empty-state browse entry. About philosophy and Lifestyle works are directly shown. Native navigation follows the selected language.
Optional analytics is off by default and can be withdrawn under Me. No journal text or practice records are uploaded; no advertising tracking. Existing subscription products, current prices and privacy labels are preserved.
